items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I think he was from down there somewhere. I don't remember him.

ctx.x: Did you know Issa Gere from down there? Issa Gere used to play bass. No. Excuse me. Played bass with Pierron in the 20s.
Yeah. I think he was from down there somewhere. I don't remember him.
Yeah, well, you'd know him if you saw him. I married him up in New York. Well, how did you get the job with the Whitney Bank?
